svg.title: Thus it is the main fine action plus the prediction penalty, with the fine and outer configurations constructed from these same variables. The connector is not an independent variable. A retained coordinate is addressed at its embedded coarse site, and a vertical coordinate at its fine site. Each address fiber has at most h = |TypeFace1×ColorIndex|+|Axis×ColorIndex| members: orientation and color distinguish the members, and the coarse embedding is injective. Here is the local-to-global estimate, including the counting loss. For addressed coordinate slots q1, . . . , qk, put S(y, q) = P i dist(y, address(qi)).
